body: emily backlog promote -dry-run still hits credit balance too low; the 19 SECTION 5 items worded 'run emily backlog promote with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' were misleading (implied missing env var, not true — key is set, just out of credit) and would have sent a future session down the same dead end each time. title: HITL-11 re-confirmed dead 2026-08-14; corrected 19 misleading SECTION 5 entries
